verdict: Paid ads are not yet live; local map visibility is your only active channel.
narrative: This period, all activity is coming from your Google Business Profile — paid advertising on Meta and Google has not launched yet, so there is no spend, no paid leads, and no cost per lead to report. On the organic side, your profile appeared in local map results on 21 of the last 28 days and generated 81 direction requests, which is a meaningful signal of local interest. However, those impressions are not converting into calls — zero calls were recorded despite 77 profile views — so we are making the click-to-call prompt more prominent to close that gap. Once paid channels are live, volume across sessions, leads, and pipeline will increase substantially; the setup work required to launch those campaigns is the active priority right now.
